name: og-03-dilution-to-localized-individuals
title: The First Individual
question: Can vent pore physics concentrate a dilute vent feed strongly enough to form a persistent, localized individual rather than washing everything into the ocean?
hypothesis: Thermophoresis + convection + adsorption in evolving pores raise local concentration enough that synthesis outruns hydrolysis/leakage in a bounded geometry region; elsewhere washout dominates.
objective: Add pore geometry, adsorption, convection and thermophoresis; find where retention + concentration cross persistence thresholds.

contract.note: bigraph-schema typed ports (_type/_units/bounds) + conservation predicates; the composite built for this study must declare a ProcessContract matching this face (audited via the workbench §Contract panel).

claim: Localization occurs robustly in a bounded geometry regime: long, tight pores trap and concentrate the feed (the favorable pore clears the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime at an accumulation Peclet of 18.4, with finite-volume flux conserved to machine precision), while open or short pores wash it through at enrichment near one, and the native porosity x pore-length map localizes at about 17% of the grid (25/144 points). The very large fold- enrichment estimates at high Peclet (reduced-model roughly 1e6-1e7) are solver-sensitive above Peclet about 13, where FiPy and FEniCS diverge by up to 5.6 decades. So the defensible result is the existence and location of a localization regime, not a precise extreme- enrichment magnitude.

findings.statement: A favorable serpentinite pore (5 mm × 0.1 mm, ΔT 30 K, convective flow) clears the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime at accumulation Péclet 18.4 from the real thermophoretic + convective transport, with FVM flux conserved to machine epsilon. The corresponding fold-enrichment (reduced-model exp(Pe) ≈ 1e6–1e7, nominally ~9.6×10⁷) is an extrapolation whose magnitude is solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13 — the graded quantity is the Péclet, not the precise fold.
findings.explanation: ThermophoreticTrapProcess solves the steady accumulation column; the Péclet is the resolved readout, while the fold-enrichment = exp(beta·L) is a reduced-model extrapolation. A FiPy↔FEniCS head-to-head cross-check finds the two solvers diverge by up to ~5.6 decades at Pe ≳ 13, so the extreme fold-magnitude is not treated as a precise resolved result.

findings.statement: The native pore-localization phase map (porosity × pore length) resolves localization as a bounded region, not a single favourable/open pair: the real trap localizes above the frontier (Péclet ≈ 18, reduced-model fold ≥ 1e6) at 25/144 grid points (~17%), enrichment rising with pore length, while an open pore (porosity→1) and a 10× shorter pore wash the feed through (no localization). The map is native to og-03's own trap readouts — it no longer borrows og-02's feed/washout axes. Localization (an individual forms vs washes through) is robust; the precise fold-magnitude in the high-Péclet interior is solver-sensitive (see limitations).

evidence.observed: 25/144 (17%) localized over (porosity 0.05–0.95 × pore length 5e-4–8e-3 m); open-pore does not concentrate (~1×), 10× shorter pore ~6× — both far below the frontier

findings.explanation: Enrichment rises with pore length and vanishes with confinement/openness — the dilution/localization boundary the campaign sought, read from the real FiPy accumulation solve and rendered as the pore-localization map (Decision view). The frontier LOCATION is robust; the fold-values deep in the high-Péclet interior are a reduced-model extrapolation.

biological_validation.basis: Reaches the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime (accumulation Péclet 18.4) with controls not concentrating — localization is real; the precise fold-magnitude is a solver-sensitive reduced-model extrapolation, not asserted as a hard benchmark.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real transport (thermophoresis + convection) explains the geometry threshold for localization; it explains that strong concentration occurs, while the exact fold in the high-Péclet interior remains solver-sensitive.

limitations: Enrichment uses the accumulation-column reduced model (exp(Pe_acc)) with one geometry calibration to Baaske; the full 2-D convection-roll enrichment is not solved.

Enrichment MAGNITUDE is solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13 — a FiPy↔FEniCS (dolfinx) head-to-head cross-check of the same spatial-transport face finds the two solvers diverge by up to ~5.6 decades in that regime, where the trap's Péclet ≈ 18 sits. So the ~1e6–1e7-fold figures are reduced-model extrapolations a resolved FEM solver does not confirm; the robust result is that localization occurs, not the exact fold. Per the resolved campaign decision, og-03's enrichment gates are now graded at the resolvable Péclet (the primary gate enrichment-resolved-within-convergence, log10_enrichment > 0 within Pe_acc ≲ 13); the ≥10⁶-fold / ~10⁸ figures are REPORTED as the closed-cell/reduced-model values, not gated as a pass.

The Mechanism-view trap→network coupling is a reduced, enrichment-capped (60×) illustration, not a graded result; the quantitative in-pore network persistence is carried by the downstream enclosed-network studies.

og-03 concentrates a SINGLE tracer. The enrichment-field co-localization map (viva_genesis/colocalization_map.py) sweeps the eight-solute MIXTURE over (Péclet × Soret) with the FEM-calibrated surrogate and finds the mixture FRACTIONATES rather than co-localizing in one thermophoretic pore — the fractionation is SORET-DRIVEN — low-S_T solutes (e.g. ammonium) lag the strongly-thermophoretic species, so the co-localization index drops to ~0.18 in the strong-Soret regime (rising toward ~1 where the Soret contrast is weak). A candidate incompatibility. Adsorption is kinetically negligible over the pore transit at prebiotic rates (FEM effective mobile fraction 0.93–1.0 even at k_ads=0.1), so it is NOT the cause. After the surrogate↔FEM reconciliation (kinetic-adsorption fix + contact-time calibration) the surrogate now agrees with the dolfinx reference within ~2–19% (was ~35–90% off) — e.g. coloc_index 0.176 (surrogate) vs 0.171 (FEM) at Pe=1/×8 — so verdict AND degree agree, with only a small residual model-structure difference. And in the resolved FLOW-THROUGH pore enrichment is strongest at low Péclet and washes out as flow rises (1/(1+Pe/pe0)), so og-03's extreme convection-enhanced fold belongs to the closed-cell (recirculating) regime, distinct from the resolved flow-through result.

resolved_uncertainties: A geometric threshold exists — the native (porosity × pore length) map localizes at ~17% of the grid (favourable pores concentrate strongly, open/short pores wash through). Localization is robust to solver choice.
The Decision map is native to og-03's own trap readouts (enrichment / Péclet), no longer borrowed from og-02.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise fold-enrichment in the high-Péclet interior (reduced-model ~1e6–1e7) — a resolved FEM solver (FiPy↔FEniCS) diverges by up to ~5.6 decades above Pe ≈ 13, so the exact magnitude is not pinned.
Whether a concentrated autocatalytic network, once enclosed, persists better in the pocket than in the well-mixed bulk — pursued downstream (og-04/og-05 enclose the network).

Whether any pore regime co-localizes the FULL prebiotic mixture rather than one tracer — the enrichment-field map finds the mixture fractionates in the strong-Soret regime (co-localization index ~0.18; surrogate 0.176 vs FEM 0.171, agreeing within ~2–19%) because low-S_T species like ammonium lag the strong thermophoretic ones, so the species a protocell needs together may not concentrate in the same place; a candidate incompatibility to map across (Péclet × Soret) and across the Soret uncertainty brackets.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Quantify how retention time at the localization frontier sets network persistence inside the trapped pocket (optional refinement; not blocking the localization result).

behavior_tests.name: thermophoretic-enrichment-reproduces-baaske
behavior_tests.description: The thermophoretic trap concentrates the dilute feed. The reduced accumulation column reaches the Baaske-2007 extreme figure (~10^8-fold, Pe_acc ≈ 18.4) in the favorable pore, but that sits ABOVE the demonstrated solver-convergence range: the resolved dolfinx FEM saturates (~10^2-fold) past Pe_acc ≈ 13 (spatial-transport-solver-comparison), so the >10^6 figure is a flow-through reduced-column exp(Pe) extrapolation / closed-cell figure, not a resolved result. Per "no acceptance gate outside demonstrated convergence" the magnitude is REPORTED here, not gated as a pass; localization within the resolvable range (Pe_acc ≲ 13) is the gated claim (see enrichment-resolved-within-convergence).

pass_if.detail: reduced-column Pe_acc ≈ 18.4 (~10^8-fold) reported as the closed-cell/reduced-model figure; the resolved FEM does not confirm it past the convergence-verified Pe_acc ≈ 13

behavior_tests.name: enrichment-resolved-within-convergence
behavior_tests.description: Within the FEM-trustworthy / convergence-verified Péclet range (Pe_acc ≲ 13, spatial-transport-solver-comparison), the resolved thermophoretic field DOES concentrate the feed above its inflow — a bounded individual forms. This is the honest, solver-agnostic localization claim (both FiPy and dolfinx agree in this range); the far larger reduced-column figure above Pe_acc ≈ 13 is reported separately (thermophoretic-enrichment-reproduces-baaske), not gated.

measure.detail: localization occurs within the resolvable range (positive enrichment

pass_if.detail: log10_enrichment > 0 (the resolved trap concentrates above inflow within Pe_acc ≲ 13)

behavior_tests.name: retention-beats-destruction
behavior_tests.description: A net-accumulation region exists where the trap concentrates enough that synthesis outruns hydrolysis/leakage. The ≥10^6-fold figure is the reduced-model (closed-cell) extrapolation; the gated claim is the resolved net-accumulation within the convergence-verified Péclet range (Pe_acc ≲ 13, spatial-transport-solver-comparison), so the magnitude is REPORTED, not gated on the un-converged ≥10^6 value.

measure.detail: log10 of the settled enrichment fold (reduced column; resolved value within Pe_acc ≲ 13)

pass_if.detail: reduced-column ≥10^6-fold reported as the closed-cell figure; net accumulation within demonstrated convergence is the gated claim (enrichment-resolved-within-convergence)

behavior_tests.name: open-pore-control-does-not-concentrate
behavior_tests.description: An open pore (porosity → 1) lets the dilute feed wash through — no individual forms (enrichment ~1). The washout-wins region mapped by the control.

pass_if.detail: enrichment collapses to ~1 in the open-pore control

behavior_tests.name: enrichment-exponential-in-pore-length
behavior_tests.description: Enrichment is exponential in pore length (Baaske's geometry threshold) — a 10× shorter pore drops far below the favorable accumulation.

pass_if.detail: short pore enriches ≥100× less than the favorable pore

behavior_tests.name: spatial-flux-conserved
behavior_tests.description: The FiPy accumulation column conserves flux (FVM balance residual ~ machine epsilon).

conclusion: The real FiPy thermal trap localizes a dilute feed into a bounded region of pore geometry and, in its own native (porosity × pore length) Decision map, draws the geometry threshold separating concentrated individuals from washed-out bulk. Feeds og-04 (mineral compartments) a concentrated starting pocket. Localization holds; the precise enrichment magnitude is caveated as a reduced-model extrapolation.
